documents.title: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release

analysis.summary: Kross Limited reported its Q2 and H1 FY27 financial and operational performance, highlighting strong revenue growth driven by the commercial vehicle and trailer segments. Management noted that expanded capacities and backward integration initiatives, such as the seamless tube facility and extruded axle beam process, are progressing well and supporting operational capabilities. While raw material and consumable cost pressures impacted margins, recent price revisions with customers are expected to support performance in the upcoming quarters. The company remains focused on capacity expansion, cost discipline, and increasing export contributions. Kross Limited reported strong operational and financial performance for Q2 and H1 FY27, driven by robust OEM demand in the M&HCV segment and consistent tractor and agri segment demand.

guidance.claim: Management expects overall volumes and historically H2 to be 20% higher than H1.
guidance.quote: Overall volumes and historically also H2 is always 20% up on H1.

guidance.claim: Management expects exports this year to be 45% higher than the previous year.
guidance.quote: Year-on-year, we expect this year to be 45% higher than our previous year.

guidance.claim: Management stated that Q3 and Q4 volumes are expected to be stronger than Q2.
guidance.quote: Q3 and Q4 volumes expected to be stronger than Q2 and historically also H2 is always 10-15% up than H1.

guidance.claim: Capacity utilisation is expected to improve in the coming quarters.
guidance.quote: Capacity expansion investments are beginning to support growth, with utilisation expected to improve in the coming quarters.

guidance.claim: Tractor and agri segment momentum is expected to continue into Q3.
guidance.quote: Momentum expected to continue into Q3; contribution of this segment set to rise over the coming years.

guidance.claim: Kross is well positioned to deliver healthy growth in FY27.
guidance.quote: With healthy order books, sustained demand in the trailer and tractor segments, and multiple capacity expansion initiatives nearing completion, Kross is well positioned to deliver healthy growth in FY27.

guidance.claim: The management targets export contribution to reach approximately 8% in the next two years.
guidance.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.

guidance.claim: The company expects a growth of 40% to 45% in its exports for this financial year.
guidance.quote: We are looking into having a growth of 40%, 45% in our exports for this financial year.

demand_outlook.claim: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.
demand_outlook.quote: The momentum in the commercial segment has continued with robust demand indicated by the OEMs.

demand_outlook.claim: Based on current indications, management expects Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2.
demand_outlook.quote: Based on our current indication, we expect Q3 and Q4 volumes to be stronger than Q2.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent and is expected to continue into Q3.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand in the Agri segment has remained consistent. We expect this momentum to continue into Q3, supported by relatively lower inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Indications suggest that the next two quarters, quarter 3 and quarter 4, should be even better for CV demand.
demand_outlook.quote: And indications do suggest that the next 2 quarters, that is quarter 3 and quarter 4 should be even better.

demand_outlook.claim: M&HCV segment momentum continued with robust OEM demand.
demand_outlook.quote: M&HCV Segment: Momentum continued with robust OEM demand.

demand_outlook.claim: Trailer segment Q2 volumes exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.
demand_outlook.quote: Trailer Segment: Q2 volumes exceeded Q4 FY26 levels.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractor and agri demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.
demand_outlook.quote: Tractor & Agri Segment: Demand remained consistent, supported by relatively low inventory levels of tractors in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Management stated that the trailer segment and commercial vehicles are performing better than expected.
demand_outlook.quote: The trailer segment -- sorry, the tractor segment is doing very well and commercial vehicles along with the trailer segment is doing better than expected.

demand_outlook.claim: OEMs have indicated strong demand from September onwards through Q3 and Q4.
demand_outlook.quote: In spite of that, there has been indications from the OEMs for a strong September Q2 and then subsequently Q3 and Q4.

demand_outlook.claim: Tractor industry data for April 2026 remained encouraging.
demand_outlook.quote: April 2026 tractor industry data remained encouraging and we remain on track to meaningfully increase the contribution of tractor segment sales to our revenues.

demand_outlook.claim: The CV business is projected to grow well in terms of volumes this year based on projections from September to March.
demand_outlook.quote: So Mihir, the CV business is supposed to grow well in terms of volumes this year.

capex_expansion.claim: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced.
capex_expansion.quote: Commercial production of extruded axle beams has commenced

capex_expansion.claim: Installed capacity for tipping jacks is 800 kits per month.
capex_expansion.quote: Installed capacity of 800 kits/month providing substantial headroom for future growth.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has commissioned and productionized its extrusion line.
capex_expansion.quote: We have finally commissioned and productionized our extrusion line.

capex_expansion.claim: A high-pressure mold line for the foundry is expected to start in Q3, which will double foundry capacity.
capex_expansion.quote: A high-pressure mold line for our foundry is expected to start in Q3. This will double our foundry capacity.

capex_expansion.claim: The axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.
capex_expansion.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

capex_expansion.claim: Progress on the seamless tube facility is on track with the piercing mill received and other equipment on the high seas.
capex_expansion.quote: Progress on the seamless tube facility is on track. Piercing mill has been received, sizing and straightening mills are on the high seas and this is progressing as per schedule.

margins_costs.claim: Management noted pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs.
margins_costs.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

margins_costs.claim: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.
margins_costs.quote: Price revisions with most OEMs and Tier-1 customers concluded, supporting profitability despite input-cost pressures.

margins_costs.claim: Extruded technology adoption offers lower material cost with no welding and lighter weight.
margins_costs.quote: Clear Competitive Edge: Lower material cost (no welding), Lighter weight and Superior technical performance resulting in improved tyre life

margins_costs.claim: Backward integration through the seamless tube facility enhances operations, reduces external dependency, and lowers production costs.
margins_costs.quote: Enhances backward integration, reduces external dependency, and lowers production costs.

margins_costs.claim: A recent steel price settlement retrospective to suppliers was given around July 15th.
margins_costs.quote: One is with the commodity price increase, that is steel for us. So steel, there has been a very recent settlement which has been given retrospective to all the suppliers. This has just happened around the 15th of July where INR4,700 per kilo has been given.

margins_costs.claim: Prices on the trailer business were increased with effect from April 1st, by approximately 3% to 5%.
margins_costs.quote: So, we have increased our prices on our trailer business with effect from 1st of April itself, right.

orders_capacity.claim: Q2 trailer segment volumes exceeded the earlier record levels of Q4 of '26.
orders_capacity.quote: Our Q2 volumes have exceeded the earlier record levels of Q4 of '26.

orders_capacity.claim: Exports currently contribute approximately 8% of the component business.
orders_capacity.quote: Exports now contribute approximately 8% of our component business.

orders_capacity.claim: Current axle beam capacity stands at 7,500 units per month.
orders_capacity.quote: Current axle beam capacity stands at 7,500 units per month

orders_capacity.claim: Volumes on axles and suspensions increased 30% year-on-year.
orders_capacity.quote: The extruded axle beam has started production and volumes on axles and suspensions have increased 30% year-on-year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company sold 226 tipping jacks in Q1 of FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: We have sold 226 in Q1 of FY27 and we hope to further scale this in the subsequent quarters.

orders_capacity.claim: Axle volumes reached approximately 9,500 numbers and suspension volumes reached around 3,200 to 3,300 numbers in Q1.
orders_capacity.quote: Yes, the overall axle volume is almost at 9,500 numbers and the suspension volumes are at around 3,200, 3,300 numbers, both mechanical and air put together.

capital_allocation.claim: The company undertook a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores.
capital_allocation.quote: The company is completely focused on capacity expansion and gearing up for the coming years, which is also witnessed by a preferential issue to the tune of INR63.6 crores.

capital_allocation.claim: The seamless tube facility project is funded through a mix of debt and internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Funded through a mix of debt & internal accruals

capital_allocation.claim: Funds from the IPO have been fully utilized as per plan for capacity expansion and working capital.
capital_allocation.quote: On our fund utilization from the IPO, we have utilized fully as per the plan.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: While we have witnessed some pressures from rising consumable and commodity costs, the price revisions, including -- concluded with the OEMs and Tier 1 customers are expected to support us during the Q3 and Q4.

risks_headwinds.claim: Management noted that forward-looking statements are subject to risks and uncertainties including fluctuations in earnings, competition, and economic growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: This presentation contains certain forward-looking statements concerning the Company’s future business prospects and business profitability, which are subject to a number of risks and uncertainties and the actual results could materially differ from those in such forward-looking statements.

risks_headwinds.claim: Demand in June and July is slightly subdued due to monsoon.
risks_headwinds.quote: The period of June, July are where demands are slightly subdued due to monsoon.

management_commitments.claim: Production trials for the seamless tube facility are planned in February or March of 2027.
management_commitments.quote: The sizing mill and straightening mills have been received and installed, and we plan to undertake production trials in February or March of 2027.

management_commitments.claim: By Q3 or Q4, trailer axles will be produced exclusively through the extruded beam process.
management_commitments.quote: This particular aspect of business by Q3 or Q4, we will be producing our trailer axles in this methodology only by the extruded beam process.

management_commitments.claim: Management is committed to building a broader customer base and increasing the contribution of exports to the overall business.
management_commitments.quote: We remain committed to building a broader customer base and increasing the contribution of exports to our overall business.

management_commitments.claim: The management plans to take the export contribution to around 8% in the next two years.
management_commitments.quote: We've mentioned this before is that the plan is to have at least 8% of exports coming in in the next two years' time.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects the high-pressure mold line for the foundry to start in Q3.
management_commitments.quote: A high-pressure mold line for our foundry is expected to start in Q3. This will double our foundry capacity.

management_commitments.claim: The axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is scheduled for commissioning by September 2026.
management_commitments.quote: Axle shaft production facility using material gathering and press forging technology is on track for commissioning by September 2026.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to do production trials for the seamless tube plant by the end of this financial year.
management_commitments.quote: So, I think by end of this financial year, we should be doing some production trials.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
